2026-08-09 commit e432acc — EMA200 was contaminated by its seed. emaSeries seeded on closes[0] with too little history: residual seed weight (1-k)^n meant 23.5% at 145 bars (Yahoo 210d default), 12.9% at 205 (GC=F 300d), 5.0% at 300 (MT5). Gold's EMA200 was $185 out on the Yahoo default path, $111 on GC=F, $21 on MT5, and the price-vs-EMA200 call that drives trend disagreed with converged on 1.3-2.3% of days. I FIRST TRIED SMA SEEDING AND IT WAS WORSE: at 300 bars Gold err went +21 -> -50 and BTC +254 -> +672, because with period 200 an SMA seed leaves only 100 recursion steps so 37% of the value is an average of OLD closes. Had already restarted the local server on that bad build; verification against a converged reference caught it and it was reverted. REAL FIX IS BAR COUNT: SMA seed only at >=3*period (EMA_SMA_SEED_MIN_MULTIPLE), DAILY_RANGE 210d/300d -> 900d, BAR_COUNT_BY_TIMEFRAME d1 300 -> 600. The 413 that shaped the old bar counts is stale — raw dump is 101kb vs a 2mb limit. IMPORTANT: gate 70 was validated on a 400-bar replay while production ran 300, so it was blessed on a different indicator; at the production window it is 4/5 not 5/5, and with the corrected build the replay stays 5/5 ROBUST. The new const also broke the replay sandbox on all 21537 steps until registered in SCALAR_CONSTS. BAR COUNT ONLY TAKES EFFECT ON BRIDGE RESTART — not yet done on either box.
